review_evidence: Complete primary inventory covers 203 Lean files; 30 files contain 131 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

Blaster implements theorem-expression optimization and SMT translation for Lean and includes proved optimization lemmas plus regression/benchmark sources that exercise theorem goals and solver behavior.

The large Tests tree was not excluded by pathname: fixed-issue and optimizer/SMT cases encode useful elaboration, theorem, rewriting, and solver prior art, and no content-level lossless bulk selector was established.
summary: Retain the complete Lean-blaster unit as reusable proof-automation infrastructure, optimization lemmas, and formal solver regression material.

summary: Surveyed all 8 in-scope files of this Blaster SMT-solver/proof-automation unit: the largest file Blaster/Smt/Translate/Application.lean, and every remaining file (Blaster/Optimize/Rewriting/OptimizeBoolBinary.lean, Blaster/Smt/Term.lean, Blaster/Smt/Translate.lean, Tests/FixedIssues.lean, Tests/FixedIssues/Issue35.lean, Tests/FixedIssues/Issue36.lean, Tests/Optimize/OptimizeBool/OptimizeBoolAnd.lean).
